description.value: Haney House is a heritage home built in 1883 by Thomas Haney, the founder of the Haney neighbourhood in Maple Ridge. Three generations of the Haney family lived here before it was donated to the city in 1979 and converted into a historic house museum. It offers a glimpse into early settler life in the Fraser Valley and is operated by the Maple Ridge Historical Society.
